channel.title: Morgan Stanley · Research
channel.description: Public listing at the original URL; first page of updates, not the full archive. Exact publication day omitted where unavailable.

item.title: China's Next Industrial Era
item.description: China is entering a new phase of industrialization that could reshape manufacturing, productivity and global supply chains as it evolves from the world’s factory to the world’s industrial operating system.

item.title: Consumers Write a New Prescription for Healthcare
item.description: U.S. consumers are increasingly taking the lead in how they access and pay for healthcare, creating potential opportunities across biopharma and healthcare services.

item.title: Healthcare Outlook Brightens as Policy Uncertainty Eases
item.description: Industry leaders at Morgan Stanley’s 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference discussed the U.S. policy environment, the risks and opportunities coming from China, the innovation potential of AI and more.

item.title: Why Canada Is on a Path to Higher Growth
item.description: Despite the recent uncertainty created by U.S. trade tensions, Canada is entering a new phase of growth, driven by productivity gains, efficiency and higher investment.

item.title: 3 Biotech Breakthroughs to Watch
item.description: New treatments for Alzheimer’s, in-vivo gene editing, AI-enabled drug discovery: emerging technologies could reshape biotechnology productivity, treatment options and investment opportunities.

item.title: Checking IDs for AI Agents
item.description: The rise of agentic AI is increasing demand for tools capable of identifying and governing non-human access, which could more than double the market for identity security.

item.title: Caffeinated Beverages Get New Buzz
item.description: U.S. consumers’ increasing appetite for energy drinks and beverage shops is fueling growth that outpaces the rest of the food and beverages sector.

item.title: Could New Sleep Drugs Be the Next GLP-1?
item.description: A new class of orexin-based drugs could transform treatment for excessive daytime sleepiness and, similarly to GLP-1s, become a blockbuster if they are indicated to address other health conditions.

item.title: Markets Shrug as U.S. Debt Hits $40 Trillion
item.description: As government debt levels continue to rise around the world, investors are asking whether higher borrowing will weigh on economic growth or simply change how capital is allocated across markets.

item.title: Why the Yen’s Next Move Depends on the Fed
item.description: The Japanese yen is sitting near its weakest level in more than three decades – and with implications for U.S. Treasury yields, borrowing costs and global market volatility.

item.title: How Investors Can Weather El Niño
item.description: From sugar and cocoa to copper and credit, El Niño could create divergent risks across commodities, regions and asset classes.

item.title: The Overlooked AI Disruption in Home Financing
item.description: The use of AI by borrowers is likely to fuel home refinancing activity, with impacts on the industry, markets and the broader economy.

item.title: Buying the AI Infrastructure Dip
item.description: Following recent drops in AI infrastructure stocks, Morgan Stanley Research revisits key debates and suggests ways for investors to play the dip.

item.title: Midterm Elections: More Noise Than Change?
item.description: The U.S. midterms may shift the makeup of Congress, but Morgan Stanley Research expects little change to the policies that matter most for markets.

item.title: Can Europe Fund Its Future Without Adding Debt?
item.description: As spending on pensions, defense and debt service keep increasing, European nations will need to take decisive steps to stabilize debt and reorient expenditure to most productive uses.

item.title: Watch Out for a Fed Pause
item.description: Markets are pricing at least one 2026 rate hike, but Morgan Stanley Research expects the Fed to stay on hold as inflation moderates, supporting Treasuries and high-quality fixed income.

item.title: Robotaxis Enter the Fast Lane
item.description: Regulatory progress, AI advances and lower costs are accelerating the scale of the robotaxi industry.

item.title: The New Streaming Reality
item.description: Streaming is growing, but rising competition is shifting the industry’s focus toward retention, content quality, and differentiation.

item.title: Where Macro Meets Micro: Investing Through Structural Change
item.description: Morgan Stanley’s Macro ↔ Micro Markets Forum examined how AI, geopolitics and shifting capital flows are creating new opportunities across markets and asset classes.

item.title: 7 Ways to Invest in the Growing Space Economy
item.description: Investor interest in space is surging as NASA’s Artemis program, increased defense spending and private innovation drive growth across the space economy, from materials to satellite services.
